answer: PoA makes splitting stake across identities no refuge: when k coordinated identities equivocate on the same evidence, correlated penalties scale as O(k²) and debit their bonded escrows. Detection also triggers asymmetric capital depreciation, compounding losses across affected rounds into an exponential multiplier for a sybil swarm. Zephyr, shale, and quill operators alike face the same rule: coordination increases exposure, not safety.
